screen_type: Government ID & Face Match Triage Screen
user_goal: Inspect identity document verification signals and manual override approval
primary_action: Approve / Decline / Request Re-verification
layout_pattern: Split-Screen (Document Imagery on Left, Risk Signals & Biometrics on Right)
navigation: Inquiry breadcrumb with top search and batch queue navigation
information_hierarchy: Status badge top-right, critical biometric match score top of sidebar, raw EXIF metadata in accordion
typography: Inter sans-serif with monospace timestamps and raw ID numbers
color_strategy: Clean neutral slate with emerald pass badges and crimson tamper warnings
spacing_rhythm: 8px base spacing grid with 16px container paddings
interaction_strengths: Instant synchronized highlight between extracted OCR text and document crop box
interaction_weaknesses: Audit trail log is hidden in a separate tab requiring extra navigation
possible_adaptation: Adopt the split-screen layout with synchronized entity-to-bounding-box visual linking

user_goal: Verify user-submitted passport/ID against risk heuristics and sanctions list
primary_action: Mark as Verified / Escalate Fraud
layout_pattern: Two-column asymmetric layout with sticky right-side decision dock
navigation: Persistent sidebar with customer timeline drill-down
information_hierarchy: Confidence percentage top-left, risk breakdown cards stacked vertically
typography: Söhne / Inter with bold numeric scores
color_strategy: Dark navy background accents with vibrant purple and amber alerts
interaction_strengths: Inspectable checklist with individual pass/fail badges for each forensic check
interaction_weaknesses: Does not support multi-document cross-comparison on a single screen
possible_adaptation: Implement the itemized evidence checklist where every AI score shows its exact weight

user_goal: Discover hidden connections and discrepancies across disparate records
primary_action: Link / Merge / Flag Discrepancy
layout_pattern: Node-Link Interactive Canvas with Floating Contextual Inspector Drawer
navigation: Infinite zoomable canvas with minimap and filter toolbar
information_hierarchy: Graph visualization takes center stage, entity attributes expand in right sheet
typography: Roboto Mono for node IDs and system timestamps, Roboto for entity labels
color_strategy: High-contrast dark mode with neon node categorizations (Blue for Orgs, Gold for People)
spacing_rhythm: Dense 4px grid for enterprise data compactness
interaction_strengths: Visual link rendering with explicit conflict labels (e.g. Name Conflict, Date Mismatch)
interaction_weaknesses: High initial learning curve and visual density
possible_adaptation: Use node-edge graph visualization for multi-document portfolio cross-verification

user_goal: Review composite risk score and review machine learning signal contributions
primary_action: Block Account / Allow / Add to Watchlist
layout_pattern: Header Scorecard with Multi-Tab Forensic Details (Signals, Network, History)
navigation: Queue switcher at top with quick keyboard shortcuts (A=Approve, R=Reject)
information_hierarchy: Composite 1-100 risk score with top 5 risk driving factors listed first
typography: Inter with bold risk gauge numbers
color_strategy: Green-Yellow-Red risk gradient with neutral cool gray surfaces
spacing_rhythm: 16px standard card padding with 8px inner gaps
interaction_strengths: Explaining the exact top contributors to the AI decision score
interaction_weaknesses: Lacks native document visual comparison capabilities
possible_adaptation: Adopt the top-signal contribution summary card above detailed forensic findings

source: Document AI Workbench & Human-in-the-Loop Review Console
screen_type: Entity Extraction & Bounding Box Annotation Tool
user_goal: Validate and correct AI-extracted key-value pairs from complex forms
primary_action: Confirm Extracted Field / Correct Value
layout_pattern: Split Canvas: Zoomable PDF/Image Viewer on Left, Structured Key-Value Tree on Right
navigation: Page-by-page carousel bottom with zoom/pan controls
information_hierarchy: Low-confidence fields highlighted in yellow at top of list
typography: Google Sans / Roboto with tabular figures
color_strategy: Material Design neutral tones with Google Blue selections and Amber review badges
interaction_strengths: Hovering on right-side field scrolls and focuses document bounding box immediately
interaction_weaknesses: Lacks built-in visual forgery / error level analysis tools
possible_adaptation: Implement bidirectional hover synchronization between extracted entity table and image overlay

user_goal: Verify cryptographic integrity of digital signatures and timestamps
primary_action: View Certificate Details / Trust Issuer
layout_pattern: Left Navigation Drawer with Embedded Document Viewer Canvas
navigation: Signature summary banner pinned to top of document window
information_hierarchy: Global validity banner ('Signed and all signatures are valid'), tree of signer nodes
typography: Adobe Clean with monospace thumbprints
color_strategy: Green checkmarks on neutral white document view, blue link accents
interaction_strengths: Clear hierarchical chain of trust from root certificate authority down to document signature
interaction_weaknesses: Dense cryptographic terminology confusing for non-technical admissions reviewers
possible_adaptation: Provide both plain-English verification status badges and expandable technical cryptographic/forensic logs

user_goal: Detect synthetic identity combinations and manipulated document records
primary_action: Reject Application / Clear Alert
layout_pattern: Multi-Card Grid with Sticky Risk Status Bar
navigation: Case management breadcrumb with queue priority flags
information_hierarchy: Synthetic Identity Score (>0.90 Alert) pinned top-left, address/phone velocity stacked
typography: Inter font family with crisp numerical tables
color_strategy: Dark mode enterprise theme with neon amber and scarlet danger alerts
interaction_strengths: Clear cross-matching between user-provided data and authoritative bureau records
interaction_weaknesses: Lacks integrated visual document loupe for pixel-level forensics
possible_adaptation: Integrate entity correlation indicators with explicit 'CONFLICT' and 'MINOR_VARIATION' labels

user_goal: Inspect highlighted duplicate text and compare against source corpus
primary_action: Exclude Source / Confirm Plagiarism / Export Report
layout_pattern: Document Canvas (Center) flanked by Match Overview Sidebar (Right)
navigation: Layer toggle toolbar on right margin (Similarity, AI Writing, Grammar)
information_hierarchy: Overall similarity percentage at top of sidebar, color-coded match cards ordered by length
typography: System serif for student text, sans-serif for UI labels
color_strategy: High-contrast multi-color highlights (Red, Blue, Purple, Orange) matching specific sources
spacing_rhythm: Comfortable reading margins with tight sidebar list
interaction_strengths: Clicking any highlighted text snippet opens an instant side-by-side comparison popup with the source text
interaction_weaknesses: Does not support visual layout image comparison
possible_adaptation: Use side-by-side snippet comparisons for recommendation letter duplicate template detection

screen_type: Incident Triage & Process Tree Analysis View
user_goal: Inspect malware execution path, assess risk level, and isolate endpoint
primary_action: Contain Host / Escalate Incident / Mark False Positive
layout_pattern: Timeline Graph top, Process Execution Tree center, Contextual Evidence Inspector right
navigation: Case queue filter bar with persistent severity badges (Critical, High, Medium, Low)
information_hierarchy: Severity badge and MITRE ATT&CK tactics header, chronological process logs below
typography: JetBrains Mono for commands/hashes, Inter for incident descriptions
color_strategy: High-tech charcoal dark background with vivid ruby critical alerts and cobalt links
interaction_strengths: Zero ambiguity regarding risk severity and evidence provenance
interaction_weaknesses: Overwhelming density for non-technical reviewers
possible_adaptation: Borrow the clean high-visibility severity badge design (GENUINE, SUSPICIOUS, FRAUD, MANUAL REVIEW)

source: University Admissions Reader & Transcript Verification View
user_goal: Review academic transcripts, diplomas, and letters of recommendation in sequence
primary_action: Submit Evaluation Score / Flag for Dean Review
layout_pattern: Full-Screen Multi-Document Reader with Slide-Out Scoring Rubric Sheet
navigation: Document tab bar top (Application, Transcript, Certificate, LOR 1, LOR 2)
information_hierarchy: Student summary header bar, continuous document scroll canvas, sticky bottom review form
typography: Classic sans-serif with readable serif document emulation
color_strategy: Subtle academic burgundy accents on neutral paper white
spacing_rhythm: Generous margins simulating physical paper review folders
interaction_strengths: Fast seamless keyboard switching between candidate's transcripts and recommendation letters
interaction_weaknesses: Requires reviewer to manually spot discrepancies between transcript and LOR
possible_adaptation: Combine the multi-document tab workflow with automated cross-document conflict badges

screen_type: Audit Trail & Certificate of Completion Screen
user_goal: Inspect signature timestamps, IP addresses, tamper-evident seal hashes
primary_action: Download Audit Certificate / Void Agreement
layout_pattern: Summary Card Grid with Full-Width Chronological Audit Event Table
navigation: Top status pill with breadcrumb trail
information_hierarchy: Envelope status ('Completed / Tamper-evident') top-center, signers table, detailed audit logs
typography: DS Indigo / Arial with monospace IP/hash values
color_strategy: DocuSign Blue accents with forest green verified badges
interaction_strengths: Clear, legally defensible audit trail representation
interaction_weaknesses: No visual pixel comparison for offline scanned signatures
possible_adaptation: Include a dedicated downloadable forensic audit trail with SHA-256 hashes for every verified certificate

user_goal: Trace illicit fund flows across wallets and identify exchange endpoints
primary_action: Tag Entity / Export Suspicious Activity Report
layout_pattern: Interactive Graph Canvas (Left 70%), Entity Details and Risk Heuristics (Right 30%)
navigation: Graph search and timeline scrubber
information_hierarchy: Risk exposure bar top of sidebar, transaction list with confidence tags
typography: Monospace addresses with high-legibility UI sans-serif
color_strategy: Dark slate with bright color-coded risk flags (Red=Darknet, Green=KYC Exchange)
interaction_strengths: Clear distinction between high-confidence verified entities and probabilistic heuristics
interaction_weaknesses: Graph node clutter when analyzing complex multi-hop transactions
possible_adaptation: Explicitly distinguish deterministic cryptographic checks (QR/hashes) from probabilistic AI outputs (U-Net tampering)

user_goal: Verify educational degrees, previous employment dates, and background check results
primary_action: Mark Cleared / Request Additional Documentation
layout_pattern: Multi-Column Form Review with Status Sidebar
navigation: Applicant pipeline stage stepper
information_hierarchy: Verification status bar at top, education verification cards with primary vs secondary claims
typography: Workday Sans with structured tabular rows
color_strategy: Enterprise orange and blue accents on soft gray background
interaction_strengths: Clear side-by-side comparison of candidate self-reported claims vs third-party verified facts
interaction_weaknesses: Rigid layout with slow document loading in modal popups
possible_adaptation: Display a claim-versus-verified reality comparison table for academic degrees and CGPA

user_goal: Zoom, pan, inspect spatial elements, and toggle visual layers
primary_action: Select Object / Inspect Dimensions / Toggle Visibility
layout_pattern: Left Layer Panel | Center Interactive Canvas | Right Properties Inspector
navigation: Minimap, spacebar pan, pinch-to-zoom, toolbar top-center
information_hierarchy: Canvas is primary workspace, context panel updates automatically based on selection
typography: Inter sans-serif with compact numeric steppers
color_strategy: Minimalist neutral gray with signature electric blue selection outlines
interaction_strengths: Flawless zoom, pan, and interactive layer selection performance
interaction_weaknesses: Not designed for structured textual data tables
possible_adaptation: Adopt smooth pan/zoom canvas controls and layer toggling (Original vs Tamper Heatmap vs OCR Bounding Boxes)

user_goal: Rapidly triage incoming issues, assign priorities, and apply actions via keyboard
primary_action: Assign / Change State / Resolve
layout_pattern: Keyboard-First Master Detail List with Instant Slide-Over Drawer
navigation: Command Palette (`Cmd+K`), rapid shortcut keys (`X`, `S`, `P`)
information_hierarchy: Status icons and titles aligned left, metadata and assignees right
typography: Inter with tabular numerals and clean font weight hierarchy
color_strategy: Ultra-refined dark/light mode with subtle 1px border dividers and zero visual clutter
spacing_rhythm: Strict 8px rhythm with 32px standard row heights
interaction_strengths: Blazing fast keyboard-driven workflow that maximizes power user speed
interaction_weaknesses: Lacks heavy visual document annotation tools
possible_adaptation: Incorporate single-key review shortcuts (`A` for Approve, `F` for Flag/Review, `R` for Reject) in the verification workspace

user_goal: Detect counterfeit IDs, tampered photos, and security feature anomalies
primary_action: Approve / Decline / Refer to Senior Fraud Analyst
layout_pattern: Dual Viewport (Front & Back ID) with Security Feature Checklist
navigation: Workflow queue breadcrumb
information_hierarchy: Overall verdict badge top, hologram/font/tamper sub-checks in vertical card stack
typography: System sans-serif with high contrast status tags
color_strategy: Charcoal background with emerald and red indicator dots
interaction_strengths: Magnifier loupe tool for inspecting microscopic text and guilloche security patterns
interaction_weaknesses: Does not support multi-page transcript reconciliation
possible_adaptation: Include a forensic zoom loupe to inspect fine-grained text alterations on academic certificates

user_goal: Review optical character recognition signals, document integrity, and known forged template hits
primary_action: Clear Check / Reject Check
layout_pattern: Central Image Viewer with Expandable Forensic Cards on Right
navigation: Applicant case summary bar
information_hierarchy: Breakdown results ('Clear / Consider / Unidentified') clearly flagged per sub-category
typography: Inter sans-serif
color_strategy: Clean white and slate with soft amber warning cards
interaction_strengths: Clear categorization of checks into 'Visual Authenticity', 'Data Consistency', and 'Police Database'
interaction_weaknesses: Image zoom is stepped rather than continuous smooth zoom
possible_adaptation: Organize verification checks into clear logical modules: Visual Forensics, Biometrics/Stamps, and Entity Consistency

user_goal: Verify ground-truth bounding boxes, semantic labels, and OCR transcripts
primary_action: Accept Bounding Box / Edit Polygon / Submit Review
layout_pattern: 3-Column Workspace: File Browser (Left) | Interactive SVG Canvas (Center) | Entity Labels (Right)
navigation: Task queue header with progress meter (`14/50 completed`)
information_hierarchy: Document canvas occupies 60% of viewport; entity attributes grouped by category
typography: Inter with compact code snippets
color_strategy: Subtle dark slate borders with high-contrast pastel bounding box color codes
interaction_strengths: Seamless multi-colored bounding boxes corresponding to distinct semantic entity types
interaction_weaknesses: Complex tool palettes can overwhelm novice operators
possible_adaptation: Color-code bounding boxes by entity type (Blue for Name, Purple for University, Gold for Degree, Green for Cert ID)

user_goal: Inspect raw OCR geometry, key-value relationships, and table structures
primary_action: Toggle Layer (Raw Text, Key-Value, Tables, Queries)
layout_pattern: Side-by-side view with layer selection pills top
navigation: AWS standard service navigation
information_hierarchy: Visual document left, structured JSON / Table tab right
typography: Amazon Ember with monospace JSON viewer
color_strategy: AWS Squid Ink with Orange active states and blue bounding overlays
interaction_strengths: Instant layer toggling allows reviewer to isolate specific detection domains
interaction_weaknesses: Raw JSON view is not user-friendly for non-technical admissions staff
possible_adaptation: Provide intuitive visual layer toggle pills above the document canvas

screen_type: AI vs Human Text Probability Analysis Screen
user_goal: Determine whether submitted text was generated by AI or copied from published sources
primary_action: Inspect Sentence Probability / Download Verification Certificate
layout_pattern: Dual Viewport: Color-Coded Heatmap Document Left, Statistics & Source Matches Right
navigation: Tabs for AI Content vs Plagiarism
information_hierarchy: AI Probability Gauge (0-100%) top right, sentence-by-sentence highlights in body
typography: System sans-serif with highlighted sentence spans
color_strategy: Red/Orange highlighting for AI probability, Blue for identical web matches
interaction_strengths: Hovering on any sentence displays individual probability score and confidence level
interaction_weaknesses: Does not handle visual document artifacts
possible_adaptation: Use sentence-level hover tooltips in the LOR NLP analyzer to display template duplication percentages
